English: Khans Tent
A simple felt tent, hastily pitched on the open steppe, serving as the Khans first seat of authority. Offers little more than shelter, but marks the heart of the clan.
Clan Leaders Yurt
A sturdy yurt crafted for the clan leader, with space for council and minor treasures. More comfortable and secure than a simple tent.
Command Yurt
A larger yurt, reinforced and organized for the Khans officers and strategists, filled with maps and campaign plans.
Banner Pavilion
A resplendent pavilion adorned with the clans banners, serving as a rallying point for warriors and a symbol of unity for the horde.
Guarded Camp
A well-fortified camp with watchfires and armed guards, deterring raiders and lending security to the Khans retinue.
Stewards Shelter
A dedicated shelter for the clans stewards and administrators, enabling more efficient management of resources and supplies.
High Council Tent
A vast and well-appointed tent, the seat of the Khans council, where strategies are devised and clan disputes are settled.
Chieftains Court
A grand, semi-permanent court of felt, hide, and timber, where the Khan dispenses justice and hosts foreign dignitaries.
Royal Steppe Hall
A sprawling, semi-permanent hall of decorated wood and felt, the heart of the hordes command, resplendent with art and trophies of conquest.
Grand Khans Encampment
The ultimate seat of nomadic power: a fortified encampment with a vast hall, elaborate tents, and guarded pavilions, serving as the mobile palace for the Grand Khan and his retinue.
